name: Craft Studio
description: Photos, video, motion graphics and audio with the open-source Craft apps (FilmCraft, PhotoCraft, LightCraft, EffectCraft, SoundCraft). Agents get each app's own MCP server, confined to the task's folders, headless or live in the app when it is open; exports land in the task's results.
author: Remco Eijsackers

mcpServers.label: FilmCraft

tools.name: status
tools.description: Call this first when a task involves photos, video, motion graphics or audio. Says which Craft apps you have in this run (FilmCraft, PhotoCraft, LightCraft, EffectCraft, SoundCraft), whether each works headless or live in the user's open app, which folders it may read and write, and how to work so your results reach the user.

tools.name: delivery_spec
tools.description: Exact delivery specs for a target (frame size, aspect, fps, codec, maximum duration, loudness) and the export call per Craft app, so you don't have to guess. Targets: instagram-feed, instagram-story, instagram-reel, tiktok, linkedin-feed, linkedin-video, youtube, youtube-short, web-hero, web-image, print-a4, podcast. Without a target: the list.

target.description: One of the targets, e.g. instagram-reel
